title: Completed Jacobian homology agrees with completed ordinary conormal homology
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $C$ a finite type commutative $A$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Write $\widehat C=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}C/I^nC$ for its $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Choose a surjective $A$-algebra map $\alpha:Q=A[y_1,\ldots,y_s]\to C$, with $s\geq0$ finite and kernel $K$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Define the $C$-linear map $d_\alpha:K/K^2\to C^{\oplus s}$ by $[f]\mapsto(\alpha(\partial f/\partial y_j))_j$, and put $M_1=\ker d_\alpha$, $M_0=\operatorname{coker}d_\alpha$. For each $i\in\{0,1\}$ let $\widehat M_i=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}M_i/I^nM_i$, a $\widehat C$-module by componentwise multiplication, where $I^nM_i=(I^nC)M_i$. Let $\beta:P=\widehat{A[x_1,\ldots,x_r]}_I\to\widehat C$ be any surjective $A$-algebra map, with $r\geq0$ finite and kernel $J$. Define $d_\beta:J/J^2\to\widehat C^{\oplus r}$ by $[f]\mapsto(\beta(\partial f/\partial x_j))_j$, where derivatives on $P$ extend polynomial differentiation continuously for the $I$-adic topology. Then there are $\widehat C$-linear isomorphisms $\widehat M_1\cong\ker d_\beta$ and $\widehat M_0\cong\operatorname{coker}d_\beta$.
